task.description:
Execute fn:search-issues to check whether ISS-0113 already exists in docs/issues/.

If NOT found:
  - Execute fn:register-issue to create docs/issues/ISS-0113.json with:
    - title: Event-store idempotency fixtures contaminate shared integration state
    - status: OPEN
    - severity: MAJOR
    - category: test-isolation/idempotency-collision
    - symptom: Repeated integration execution collides with event-store rows left by other cases. Duplicate idempotency keys abort the primary operation.
    - root_cause: (to be determined in Step 1)
    - affected_areas: Event-store and idempotency integration fixtures, Instance error integration fixtures, Service-task integration fixtures
    - github_issue: https://github.com/tvolodi/R-Co/issues/376

  - File the issue on GitHub via gh issue create (if not already filed).
  - Write the resulting GitHub issue URL back to docs/issues/ISS-0113.json.

If FOUND:
  - Execute fn:update-issue to set status=IN_PROGRESS.

Return PASS with the ISS file path in artifacts_out.
acceptance_criteria: ISS file has status OPEN or IN_PROGRESS
ISS file has github_issue field with URL

result.summary: ISS-0113 found in registry. Updated status to IN_PROGRESS, linked to current handoff (193a90d3), verified GitHub issue #376 is filed.
